# bitcoinwealthpays.com

The Bitcoin Wealth Guide by MTG, the same guide as https://mtgtribe.com/bw, at this domain's root.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are built from mtglegacyai/mtgtribe (`bw/_build/build/build.py`), which builds
mtgtribe.com/bw and then this copy every time, so the two never drift apart (MTG, 22 Nov 2026). The videos play from
https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/ (Cloudflare R2). The old site (before 22 Nov 2026) is in this repo's history,
commit c432ecc; its old addresses forward to the new pages.
